dialogue.content: （こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I look forward to working with you today.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Likewise, thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。年齢、性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 18歳女性です。家族とうまくいっていません。
dialogue.English: I'm an 18-year-old woman. I'm not getting along well with my family.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはお辛いですよね・・・。どんなところがうまくいっていないと感じていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be really tough... In what ways do you feel you're not getting along?

dialogue.content: 親と意見が合わずにいつも喧嘩してしまいます。
dialogue.English: I don't see eye to eye with my parents, and we always end up arguing.

dialogue.content: 最近は口をきかないことも多いです。
dialogue.English: Lately, we often don't even speak to each other.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それはお気持ちに負担がありますよね・・今、一緒に住んでいる方はどなたがいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be a great emotional burden... Who are you currently living with?

dialogue.content: 父と母と妹です。
dialogue.English: My father, mother, and younger sister.

dialogue.content: お答えありがとうございます。ご両親と喧嘩するとのことですが、お父様とお母様とどちらと喧嘩になっていますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. You mentioned you argue with your parents; do these arguments tend to be with your father, your mother, or both?

dialogue.content: 両方です。父はあまり話をしませんが高圧的で、母は過干渉で口うるさいので、話をするのが面倒です。
dialogue.English: Both of them. My father doesn't talk much but is domineering, and my mother is over-involved and nagging, so it's draining to talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうあったんですね。。それは苦しいですよね。口を利かない日が続くとどうしていいか分からなくなりますよね。今、家ではどのような感じで過ごしていますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. That must be painful. When days go by without speaking, it's understandable to feel at a loss for what to do. How are things for you at home these days?

dialogue.content: 学校や塾で家にはほとんどいないので、あまり会話せずに済んでいます。
dialogue.English: I'm barely home because of school and cram school, so I manage to avoid talking to them much.

dialogue.content: でも受験を控えていて、そのことで嫌でも話をしないといけないので、困っています。
dialogue.English: But with my university entrance exams coming up, I have to talk to them about it whether I like it or not, which is making things difficult.

dialogue.content: ええ、受験があるのですね。それは話をすることが必要ですよね・・受験する学校のことなどでお話したいですよね？
dialogue.English: Yes, you have exams coming up. That does require you to talk... You want to discuss things like which schools to apply to, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。これから自立するといえども、受験の費用や学費などは親の世話になるため、話をしないといけないと思っています。
dialogue.English: That's right. Even though I'll be independent soon, I'll still be relying on my parents for exam fees and tuition, so I know I have to talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ちゃんと先を見透けた自立した生活のことまでお考えなんですね。
dialogue.English: That's right. It's impressive that you're thinking so far ahead about your future independent life.

dialogue.content: ご両親と意見が合わず喧嘩になるのは、どのようなことが多いのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things most often lead to disagreements and arguments with your parents?

dialogue.content: ちゃんと勉強しろとか、こっちの大学のほうがいいとか、いろんなことにケチをつけてきます。
dialogue.English: They nitpick about all sorts of things—telling me to study properly or insisting that a certain university is better.

dialogue.content: 両親の関係も良くないし、機嫌が悪いときも多いし、接するのが面倒くさいです。
dialogue.English: My parents' relationship isn't good either, they're often in a bad mood, and interacting with them feels like a chore.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・受験に集中したい中で、それは嫌な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... When you want to be focusing on your exams, that must be very distressing.

dialogue.content: ご両親は妹さんへの対応も同じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do your parents treat your younger sister the same way?

dialogue.content: 妹にも嫌な感じで接することはあります。小さい頃から両親の喧嘩が絶えず、仲介したり、妹には見せないようにして過ごしてきたつもりです。
dialogue.English: They can be unpleasant to my sister, too. My parents have argued constantly since we were little, and I've always tried to mediate or shield my sister from it.

dialogue.content: そのような状況をおひとりで抱えてこられたのですね。お辛いこともたくさんあったのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you've been shouldering that situation all by yourself. You must have gone through a lot of hardship, haven't you?

dialogue.content: はい、しんどいことも多かったです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's been very tough.

dialogue.content: 両親の喧嘩⇒機嫌が悪くなる⇒当たられて嫌な思いをする、ことが多いです。
dialogue.English: Often it's: my parents fight → they get in a bad mood → they take it out on me, and I end up feeling awful.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。ご両親の喧嘩を妹に見せたくないですし、嫌な気持ちから守ってあげたいと頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You've been trying so hard to keep your sister from seeing the fights and to protect her from those painful feelings.

dialogue.content: そのような状況の中で受験をあって、妹さんの事も守りつつ、しんどいと思います。
dialogue.English: Facing your exams in that situation, while also trying to protect your sister, must be incredibly draining.

dialogue.content: 今の状況をどなたに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked to anyone about your current situation?

dialogue.content: だから家を出たいなという気持ちがあって、でも妹を残すのも心配だし、両親の仲が悪くなって離婚したりしても嫌だなと思って迷っています。
dialogue.English: That's why I feel like I want to move out, but I'm worried about leaving my sister behind. I'd also hate it if my parents' relationship got worse and they divorced, so I'm torn.

dialogue.content: 普通に受験校としては相談しますが、こういった事情については誰にも話したことはありません。
dialogue.English: I consult people about which schools to apply to, as anyone would, but I've never talked to anyone about these family circumstances.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。よくこちらにいらしてくれましたね。家を出たくなるのは当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for coming here to talk about this. It's completely natural to want to leave home in this situation.

dialogue.content: 大学に行って家を離れるか？それとも、就職して離れるか？どのタイミングで離れようとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you thinking of leaving home by going to university, or by getting a job? When are you thinking of moving out?

dialogue.content: 行きたい大学が家から離れたところにあるので、本当は来年から一人暮らしをしたいと考えています。
dialogue.English: The university I want to attend is far from home, so ideally I'd like to start living on my own next year.

dialogue.content: でも母には近くの大学に行くように言われるし、先ほど話したような不安もあるので…。
dialogue.English: But my mother tells me to go to a nearby university, and I also have the worries I mentioned earlier, so...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。行きたい大学があるのですね。妹さんのことが心配ですよね。おいくつ年が離れていますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you have a specific university you want to attend. And you're worried about your sister, aren't you? How many years apart are you?

dialogue.content: ３つです。
dialogue.English: Three years.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。行きたい大学へは妹さんのことがが心配で受験を迷っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, are you hesitating to apply to the university you want to attend because you're worried about your sister?

dialogue.content: それと両親が離婚したら嫌だなってことです。
dialogue.English: That, and the fact that I would hate it if my parents got a divorce.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。あなたが家を出ると離婚しそうだと思うのは、どんなことが予想されますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. What makes you think they might get a divorce if you leave home? What do you imagine would happen?

dialogue.content: 喧嘩を仲裁する人がいなくなって、さらに両親の仲が悪くなったり、妹が辛い思いをしたりするのが嫌です。
dialogue.English: I'm afraid that with no one to mediate their fights, their relationship will get even worse, and my sister will have a hard time.

dialogue.content: 例えば、仲裁に入る人がいないからとかですか？
dialogue.English: For example, is it because there would be no one to step in and mediate?

dialogue.content: 行き違いでした。すいません
dialogue.English: Ah, our comments crossed. My apologies.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・。あなたは全部背負ってきたんですもんね。。
dialogue.English: I understand... You've been carrying all of this on your own shoulders, haven't you.

dialogue.content: 今のあなたの気持ちとしてどうしていきたい気持ちがありますか？
dialogue.English: Given how you're feeling right now, what would you like to do?

dialogue.content: 自分の思いを優先するなら一人暮らしをしたいけど、家族のことが心配だし、そもそも受験の話をするのが面倒だし、もう何もかも嫌になっています。
dialogue.English: If I prioritize my own feelings, I want to live on my own. But I'm worried about my family, and frankly, even talking about the exams is a hassle. I'm just fed up with everything.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね・・。ここへは家族とうまくいっていないと相談にきてくれました。お両親の喧嘩はあなたのせいではないですし、うまくいっていないのもあなたのせいではないと思います。何もかも面倒になるのも当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand... You came here to talk because you're not getting along with your family. Your parents' fighting isn't your fault, and the fact that things aren't going well isn't your fault either. It's completely natural to feel fed up with everything.

dialogue.content: 今まで一人で抱えて頑張ってきたので、あなたの気持ちを優先できるならしてもいいのかな？と思いますが、色々心配ですよね？
dialogue.English: You've been carrying this all by yourself and trying so hard for so long. Perhaps it would be okay to prioritize your own feelings now? But I know you have many worries, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。担任の先生には受験料や入学金などを出すのは親だから、親に話をしないといけないと言われていて、その面でも少し詰んでいます。
dialogue.English: That's right. My homeroom teacher told me that since my parents will be the ones paying the application and admission fees, I have to talk to them. So I feel a bit stuck in that regard as well.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。お金の面を含めて一度は話をしていかないとですよね。。先生も含めて一緒に話すとか、まずは何か進めることができそうなことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Right. You'll have to talk to them at least once, including about the financial side... Is there a first step you feel you could take to move things forward, like perhaps talking to them with your teacher present?

dialogue.content: 先生を含めて話をするのはできそうです。
dialogue.English: I think having a conversation that includes my teacher is possible.

dialogue.content: ただそのときに家庭の状況的に家を出たいといえないので、理由がちょっと弱いかなとは思いますが…。
dialogue.English: However, at that time, I can't say that I want to leave home because of my family situation, so I feel my stated reason for choosing that university might seem a bit weak...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。先生を含めて話はできそうなんですね。家をでる理由としてそこの大学は家から通うことも可能は範囲でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you think you could have a talk with your teacher included. Regarding the reason for leaving home, is that university within commuting distance?

dialogue.content: 家から通うのはちょっと厳しいと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it would be a bit difficult to commute from home.

dialogue.content: ただ家庭が円満だったらそこに行きたいかというと自信がなくて、ただただ家を離れたいだけな気もします。
dialogue.English: But, I'm not sure if I'd still want to go to that university if my family life were peaceful. I feel like I might just want to get away from home.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。家を出たい気持ちがあるからかな？と少し思ってるのですね。そこの大学へは行ってみましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you're wondering if your desire to leave home might be the main reason. Have you visited the campus?

dialogue.content: 夏休みにオープンキャンパスに行く予定にしています。
dialogue.English: I'm planning to go to their open campus during summer break.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはいいですね。キャンパスいってみたり、就職状況を調べたりしてみると、行きたい気持ちが強くなるかもしれません。まだ、知らないから今の気持ちかもしれませんし、、
dialogue.English: I see, that's a great idea. Visiting the campus and looking into job prospects might strengthen your desire to go there. Your current feelings might just be because you don't know enough about it yet.

dialogue.content: そうですね。そこはあまり冷静じゃないと感じているので、ちゃんと大学に行ってみて判断したいと思います。
dialogue.English: You're right. I feel I'm not being very level-headed about that part, so I want to actually visit the university and then decide.

dialogue.content: 親に話すのだけはずっと憂鬱ですが、いつかは話をしないといけないですもんね…。
dialogue.English: I'm still dreading talking to my parents about it, but I know I have to do it at some point...

dialogue.content: それは憂鬱になる気持ちは当然です。。勇気と気合がいりそうですよね・・
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable to feel that way... It sounds like it will take a lot of courage and determination.

dialogue.content: あなたなら、文句を言われるのは当然だと心して行きたい大学の費用を出してもらうことを優先して対応できるのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: I believe you're capable of bracing yourself for their complaints and prioritizing the goal of getting them to pay for the university you want to attend.

dialogue.content: そうですね。それで家族がどうなろうと、私の責任ではないですよね…？
dialogue.English: You're right. And whatever happens to my family as a result of that, it's not my responsibility, is it...?

dialogue.content: そうです。あなたのせいではありません。
dialogue.English: That's right. It is not your fault.

dialogue.content: あなたは自分の希望や将来を考えていいのです。
dialogue.English: You are allowed to think about your own hopes and your future.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。私の気持ちを伝えてみます。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll try to tell them how I feel. Thank you.

dialogue.content: あなたは今まで十分頑張ってきています。こんどはあなたのことを一番に考えていいのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: You've done more than enough up to now. I think it's okay for you to put yourself first this time.

dialogue.content: それで反対されたらどうしたらいいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: If they oppose it, what do you think I should do?

dialogue.content: 反対されることも想定して、先生にも話すときに協力してもらうようにしたり、学費を出してもらえるように説得するしかないと思います。
dialogue.English: Anticipating that they might oppose it, I think the path forward is to ask your teacher for support during the conversation and focus on persuading your parents to cover the tuition.

dialogue.content: わかりました。まずは先生や両親にどうやって話をするか考えてみたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Understood. First, I'd like to think about how to approach the conversation with my teacher and my parents.

dialogue.content: 後は、奨学金を借りるなどを含めて、色々調べたり、先生にも事前に相談するとかも必要ですね。
dialogue.English: Also, it would be a good idea to research other options, such as scholarships and student loans, and to consult with your teacher about it beforehand.

dialogue.content: 話してみてどうしたらいいかわからなくなっていたけど、気が楽になりました。
dialogue.English: I was at a loss for what to do, but talking about it has made me feel much more at ease.

dialogue.content: 奨学金は少しずつ調べ始めているので、先生にも相談してみたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I've already started looking into scholarships a little, so I'd like to try consulting my teacher about that as well.

dialogue.content: そうですね。あなたは今まで喧嘩の仲裁をしたり、気遣いをしてこられました。相手にどう話をしたらいいのか？など空気を読めるしことができるような気がします。うまくできると思います。受験まであと少し頑張ってほしいです。応援しています。
dialogue.English: Yes. You've been mediating fights and being considerate of others for a long time. I feel you have a great ability to read the room and figure out how to talk to people. I'm confident you can handle this well. Your exams are just around the corner, so hang in there. I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話足りなかったこともあるかもしれません。少し気持ちが楽になったようですが、また何かありましたら、ご相談にいらしてください。一緒に考えたいと思います
dialogue.English: There may be more we didn't have time to cover today. It sounds like you're feeling a bit more at ease, but if anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to come and talk again. I'd be happy to think things through with you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。また相談に来ます。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. I will come back for another consultation.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれで終わりたいと思います。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I think we'll end our session here for today. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。また機会があればよろしくお願いします。終了メッセージ流します）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much for today. I hope we have the opportunity to speak again. Sending the closing message now.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much!)
